tasks.answer: Batch compensation workspace for standard, special and review steps. batchId is required; the screen also needs query, auth and router providers and handles offline/conflict states.

No dedicated special-passenger booking-list variant surfaced in the catalog. The closest match is the general TravelerBookingListScreen (paginated traveler booking list with search and filters; navigate required, initialStatus optional, queries/actions permission-gated); special-passenger behavior would have to be built on top of it.

PasswordInput = password field with show/hide labels and a form-field error; no required props. Error display: it must be used inside UiFormField, and the error is a string rendered by that field wrapper (the input only takes the error styling/state). Shared base ui.UiPasswordInput (@/components/ui/form, requiredProps showLabel/hideLabel) behaves the same way but takes a boolean error and also relies on UiFormField for the message.

Search bar: business.SearchBar, import @/components/business/mobile, requiredProps value/placeholder/onChange (onFilter optional adds the filter icon button). Filter panel: business.FilterSheet, same import path, requiredProps visible/title/children/onClose (onConfirm runs before closing).

Global dialog that subscribes to the auth recovery store and lazily renders its view; mount it once near the app root (it renders null while no recovery event is pending). No required props. Its inner view is common.AuthRecoveryDialogView (@/components/common/auth-recovery-dialog-view, requires detail).

notes: Per query, layers observed: Q1 feature only (top 2: FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen, FlightDelayEventCreateScreen). Q2 feature + shared-ui (feature: TravelerBookingListScreen, BookingStatusBadge; shared-ui: InfiniteListFooter, UiList). Q3 feature + shared-ui (feature: auth.PasswordInput, ForgotPasswordPage; shared-ui: ui.UiPasswordInput, common.Forbidden). Q4 shared-ui + feature (shared-ui: business.SearchBar, business.FilterSheet; feature: TravelerBookingListScreen, FlightDelayCompensationListScreen). Q5 shared-ui + feature (shared-ui: AuthRecoveryDialog, AuthRecoveryDialogView; feature: ForgotPasswordPage, SignInPage). Every search used --limit 5 --details --per-layer 2; no get calls and no project files read.
